# appmixer_acl (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appmixer_acl" "example" {
  type = "user"
  rules = [
    {
      role       = "admin"
      resource   = "*"
      action     = ["read", "write", "delete"]
      attributes = ["*"]
    },
    {
      role       = "viewer"
      resource   = "flow"
      action     = ["read"]
      attributes = []
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rules` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `type` (String) ACL type, e.g. "user" or "group".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (Set of String)
- `attributes` (Set of String)
- `resource` (String)
- `role` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import appmixer_acl.example components
```
